about.label: The team
about.title: ABOUT.TXT
about.heading: Behind Ensor.Logs
about.body:
That's me in the photo, next to who actually runs the house 😂: my wife ❤️, architect Nina Marquina — and our Schnauzer Toffu, the household guardian.

Systems builder by day, gamer by night. I work technology with one rule: it has to solve something real. Everything you see in this room runs on my own server — if I recommend it, it's because I use it.

me.label: Ensor
me.title: ENSOR.BIO
me.heading: Ensor — Systems Engineer
me.body:
My name is Ensor, systems engineer with 10+ years of experience in this geek world.

These days I'm focused on bringing AI into real development: applications, domotics and concrete cases in tourism and construction — not theory, projects that actually work.

Need my services? Feel free to contact me:

dev.label: Workstation
dev.title: SERVICES.EXE
dev.heading: Web dev · Apps · AI
dev.body:
Projects ship from these monitors:

• Custom web development and applications
• Process automation with AI and agents
• Systems architecture, APIs and integrations

Need something like this? You can request my services. Full portfolio: coming soon.

server.label: The rack
server.title: INFRA.SYS
server.heading: Server & Self-hosting
server.body:
The rack runs Ubuntu + Docker: Home Assistant, backups, the internal network and the services behind this very website.

I set up the same for homes and businesses: local servers, NAS, automatic backups and owned services — no endless subscriptions.

iot.label: Domotics
iot.title: DOMOTICA.SYS
iot.heading: Domotics & IoT
iot.body:
Every device in this room reports to Home Assistant: bulbs, plugs, temperature, humidity and air quality sensors, the smart lock and the camera.

I install and configure the same for you:

• Lighting and climate automation
• Sensors, alerts and monitoring
• Security: smart locks and cameras
• All local — works even when the internet is down

fun.label: Personal zone
fun.title: OFFLINE.MODE
fun.heading: Offline mode
fun.body:
The Nintendo Switch is my go-to console: Super Smash Bros, Zelda and Mario Kart until my thumbs hurt.

The personal touches aren't decoration: they're a reminder that technology is for living better, not for living at work.

legal.title: Legal
legal.subtitle: Legal notice, privacy, cookies and accessibility — all in one page.

aviso.title: Legal notice
aviso.body:
ensorlogs.com is a personal brand and portfolio site operated by Ensor (Venezuela). All published content — text, code, images and videos — is his own work unless stated otherwise.

Use of this site is informational: the described services (development, domotics, support) are contracted by direct agreement between the parties, not by merely using this website. Continuous availability and error-free content are not guaranteed.

Reproduction of the content for commercial purposes is not allowed without prior authorization.

privacidad.title: Privacy
privacidad.body:
This site uses no analytics and no third-party trackers.

The only personal data collected is what you voluntarily send through the contact form: name, email, phone/WhatsApp and message. It is processed with Brevo (mail provider, EU servers) solely to reply to you and handle service requests.

Your data is never sold or shared. You can request rectification or deletion of your information at any time through the same contact form.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body:
This site uses a single technical cookie: NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers your preferred language (Spanish or English). It is strictly necessary for the site to work and collects no personal data.

There are no advertising, analytics or tracking cookies. Since there are no non-essential cookies, no consent banner is required.

accesibilidad.title: Accessibility
accesibilidad.body:
ensorlogs.com is built to be usable by everyone:

• Full keyboard navigation (hotspots, menu and forms are real button/link elements)
• Aria labels on interactive controls and descriptive image alt text
• High contrast on a dark background with legible typography
• Content available in Spanish and English

If you find an accessibility barrier, report it through the contact form and I will fix it.
